project.name: fitness-trainer-performance-dashboard
project.description: High-contrast dark athletic telemetry dashboard for trainers and athletes tracking biometrics, completion ratios, phase progression and step-by-step exercise routines.

global_requirements.layout: Dark app shell with a trainer header banner on top, a routed outlet in the middle and a toast host at the bottom.

regions.name: trainer-header
regions.content: elements: trainer/athlete photo avatar, headline 'PERSONAL TRAINER', website URL link, primary navigation arrow controls (previous arrow, next arrow); data: TrainerProfile avatar, display name, website URL; states: loading (avatar skeleton) | empty (placeholder avatar) | error (fallback headline) | success; interactions: hover and keyboard focus highlight on arrows and link, click arrows navigates; a11y: role=banner, aria-label on arrow buttons, link has discernible text

regions.name: main-outlet
regions.content: elements: routed slot for /dashboard and /routines; data: router state; states: loading | success; interactions: route navigation; a11y: role=main

regions.name: toast-host
regions.content: elements: toast stack slot for biometric threshold alerts and exercise step completion notices; data: Notification messages; states: empty | success; interactions: auto-dismiss, click to dismiss; a11y: role=status, aria-live=polite

core_services: Biometric Telemetry Service — ingests live streams for heart rate (bpm), respiratory/lung capacity and training load/weight volume shown on the dashboard
Toast & Notification Store — displays real-time alerts when biometrics exceed zone thresholds or when exercise steps are completed
Auth & Trainer Profile Store — manages the current trainer/athlete session profile and avatar media shown in the header

shared_ui.name: Trainer Header Banner
shared_ui.purpose: Hero athlete avatar, headline title, web link and quick action arrows
shared_ui.content: elements: hero athlete avatar, headline 'PERSONAL TRAINER', website URL link, quick action arrows (previous, next); data: TrainerProfile.avatar, TrainerProfile.websiteUrl; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover/focus on arrows and link, click navigates; a11y: role=banner, aria-label on arrows
shared_ui.a11y: role=banner; arrow buttons have aria-label; focus visible

shared_ui.name: Biometric Telemetry Tiles
shared_ui.purpose: Icon-driven status cards for heart rate, respiratory rate and weight volume
shared_ui.content: elements: heart icon + label 'Heart Rate' + value BiometricMetric.heartRate bpm + detail label; lungs icon + label 'Respiratory Rate' + value BiometricMetric.respiratoryRate + detail label; dumbbell icon + label 'Weight Volume' + value BiometricMetric.trainingLoad + detail label; data: BiometricMetric.heartRate, respiratoryRate, trainingLoad; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover highlight, live value updates; a11y: role=group per tile with aria-label
shared_ui.a11y: each tile role=group with aria-label combining label and value

shared_ui.name: Comparison Split Bars
shared_ui.purpose: Horizontal percentage split bars comparing training load (e.g. 30%/70% vs 50%/50%)
shared_ui.content: elements: two horizontal split bars, first 30%/70% and second 50%/50%, segment percentage labels, category label; data: TrainingRatio.primaryPercentage, secondaryPercentage, categoryLabel; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover tooltip on segments; a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow per segment
shared_ui.a11y: role=progressbar; aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-label per bar

shared_ui.name: Radial Gauge Indicator
shared_ui.purpose: Dual circular progress rings showing target progress percentages (e.g. 80% and 20%) with centered step labels
shared_ui.content: elements: two progress rings (80% and 20%), centered percentage text, centered step label per ring; data: PhaseProgress.completionPercentage; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover tooltip; a11y: role=meter with aria-valuenow per ring
shared_ui.a11y: role=meter; aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-label per ring

shared_ui.name: Chevron Stepper Timeline
shared_ui.purpose: 4-stage horizontal arrow progress bar representing workout sequence phases
shared_ui.content: elements: four labeled chevrons 'STEP 01', 'STEP 02', 'STEP 03', 'STEP 04'; data: PhaseProgress.phaseName, status; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover/focus, click selects phase; a11y: role=list of steps, aria-current=step on active
shared_ui.a11y: role=list; aria-current=step on the active chevron; status announced in label

shared_ui.name: Exercise Step Cards
shared_ui.purpose: Stacked vertical cards with sequential workout instructions
shared_ui.content: elements: stacked cards labeled 'STEP 01' and 'STEP 02' each with title and instruction body, completion checkmark; data: WorkoutStep.stepNumber, title, description, isCompleted; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: keyboard focusable, click/Enter marks details; a11y: role=listitem, tabindex=0
shared_ui.a11y: role=list with listitem cards; keyboard focusable with visible focus ring

shared_ui.name: Statistics Bar Widget
shared_ui.purpose: Dual-layered horizontal statistics meter for live workout intensity output
shared_ui.content: elements: label 'Workout Intensity', dual-layer horizontal track (background track plus foreground fill), value percentage; data: BiometricMetric.trainingLoad; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: live updates; a11y: role=meter with aria-valuenow
shared_ui.a11y: role=meter; aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-label

features.name: dashboard
features.description: Real-time athletic monitoring summary displaying trainer profile, live health biometrics, comparative training split ratios, circular completion rings, workout phase progress and exercise step lists. Views: dashboard summary grid. States: loading|empty|error|success. Feedback: toast alert on threshold overflow. A11y: high contrast, aria-valuenow on radial gauges. Responsive: 3-column desktop layout, single-column mobile stack.

grid.areas: "tiles tiles tiles" "bars bars gauges" "timeline timeline timeline" "steps steps steps" "stats stats stats"

regions.name: biometric-tiles
regions.content: elements: heart icon + 'Heart Rate' + BiometricMetric.heartRate bpm; lungs icon + 'Respiratory Rate' + BiometricMetric.respiratoryRate; dumbbell icon + 'Weight Volume' + BiometricMetric.trainingLoad; detail labels; data: BiometricMetric.heartRate, respiratoryRate, trainingLoad; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover highlight, live updates; a11y: role=group with aria-label per tile

regions.name: comparison-split-bars
regions.content: elements: split bar 30%/70% and split bar 50%/50% with segment percentage labels and category label; data: TrainingRatio.primaryPercentage, secondaryPercentage, categoryLabel; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover tooltip, 'Reset comparative metrics' action; a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow per segment

regions.name: radial-gauges
regions.content: elements: two rings 80% and 20% with centered percentage and step label; data: PhaseProgress.completionPercentage; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover tooltip; a11y: role=meter with aria-valuenow per ring

regions.name: phase-timeline
regions.content: elements: four chevrons 'STEP 01' to 'STEP 04'; data: PhaseProgress.phaseName, status; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover/focus; a11y: role=list, aria-current=step on active

regions.name: exercise-step-cards
regions.content: elements: vertical cards 'STEP 01' and 'STEP 02' with title and instruction text; data: WorkoutStep.stepNumber, title, description; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: hover highlight; a11y: role=list with listitem cards

regions.name: statistics-bar
regions.content: elements: bottom statistics bar with dual-layer horizontal track, label 'Workout Intensity' and percentage value; data: BiometricMetric.trainingLoad; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: live updates; a11y: role=meter with aria-valuenow

actions: Stream live heart rate and respiration updates

features.name: routines
features.description: Workout execution feature where users view and track multi-phase training sessions (STEP 01 to STEP 04) and execute detailed step-by-step exercise routines. Views: list, detail, stepper view. States: loading|empty|error|success. Feedback: inline completion checkmarks and phase transition feedback. A11y: keyboard focusable step cards. Responsive: stacked card layout on smaller screens.

regions.name: phase-stepper
regions.content: elements: four chevrons 'STEP 01' to 'STEP 04', phase transition feedback, advance-to-next-phase button; data: PhaseProgress.phaseName, completionPercentage, status; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: click advances phase, keyboard focus; a11y: role=list, aria-current=step on active

regions.name: step-cards
regions.content: elements: stacked cards with STEP label, title, instruction text, inline completion checkmark, 'Mark step as completed' button; data: WorkoutStep.stepNumber, title, description, isCompleted; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: click selects step, Enter/Space activates, mark complete; a11y: keyboard focusable cards (tabindex=0), role=listitem

regions.name: step-detail
regions.content: elements: selected step title, step number, detailed instruction description, completion status indicator; data: WorkoutStep.title, description, isCompleted; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: mark complete; a11y: role=region with aria-labelledby

actions: Fetch workout steps by routine ID
